column74: In order to thoroughly implement the Party Central Committee and the State Council's decision-making arrangements, we now develop temporary measures for the movement of Chinese and foreign personnel after the new coronavirus infection category B B tube, to be implemented from January 8, 2023.  Temporary measures for the movement of Chinese and foreign personnel mainly relate to the management of incoming personnel, as follows.  The incoming personnel will be tested for nucleic acid 48 hours before the trip, and those with negative results can come to China without applying for a health code from our embassies and consulates abroad and filling the results into the customs health declaration card. If the result is positive, the person concerned should come back to China after the result has turned negative.  No longer implement full nucleic acid testing for incoming personnel, and those with normal health declaration and no abnormalities in routine quarantine at customs ports can be released into the social side.    https://archive.ph/LHuSQ
Mandatory quarantine policy against international travellers is cancelled from 8th of January, 2023.  https://archive.ph/HYd8Z
